answer: At dawn each agent must lock a refundable bond before joining a trade voyage, and the bond is slashed if the agent cheats or vanishes mid-deal. A sparrow-sized task still requires the same bond as a large one, so a Sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund thousands of bonds, and each detected fake forfeits its stake. Honest agents get their bond back after the voyage settles, so the cost falls only on attackers.
